page_title: CEL 1-1 PAL | Celta Vigo v Las Palmas 31/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky!
88' Diego Martinez decides to make a substitution. Alberto Moleiro will be replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
87' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
86' A substitution has been made. Javier Rodriguez goes off and Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) comes on.
86' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Dinko Horkas makes a comfortable save.
85' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) will take the corner.
83' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
79' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
79' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Dinko Horkas sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
77' Today's match ends for Oliver McBurnie who will be replaced by Marvin (Las Palmas).
75' It is time for a substitution. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is on for Borja Iglesias.
75' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Damian Rodriguez is replaced by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo).
72' The goal by Las Palmas won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
72' The Las Palmas players halt their celebrations as referee Juan Martinez makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
71' The attendance is 18549.
70' Goal! Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:2.
69' Las Palmas seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
67' The resulting corner from Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) comes to nothing.
65' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Dinko Horkas.
63' Las Palmas are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
60' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
56' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
53' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes.

48' 1 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) and Oliver McBurnie gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the right side of the goal. 1:1.
46' Claudio Giraldez makes a switch. Fernando Lopez is coming on in place of Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) at the start of the second period.
46' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jailson comes on the pitch for Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jose Campana (Las Palmas) comes off for Dario Essugo.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Diego Martinez gives a chance to Sandro Ramirez and Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

45+2' 1 - 0 Brilliant finish! Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Borja Iglesias, then produced a nice strike into the top right corner. The score is 1:0.

45+2' Celta Vigo hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

44' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Vicente Guaita pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the middle of the goal.
43' Las Palmas are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
42' Juan Martinez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) brought his opponent down.
39' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' The possession of the ball – 60:40.
32' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
31' The referee signals a free kick. Celta Vigo are going to take it from long range.
27' Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas) is substituted due to injury. Diego Martinez gives a chance to Dinko Horkas.
24' The game is interrupted. Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas) suffers a horrific injury!

22' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
20' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
18' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
18' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Vicente Guaita was alert and made a comfortable save.
16' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) is flagged for offside.
13' Dangerous play by Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo). Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Celta Vigo force their opponents to concede a corner.
11' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though.
8' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
